verdicts.V3: V3 THE HONEST STATEMENT -- THE FOOTING CRISIS, FULLY QUANTIFIED: the theory's single constant is under a 1.3-2x strain (SPARC band 1.28-1.33x, MIGHTEE 1.81-1.97x of the DE anchor; the seesaw-alt footing at 1.208x is the Z-exact rung between them).
